title: Smart Janpath — Redevelopment of Janpath Road (Vani Vihar to Sishu Bhawan Square)
address: Janpath Road, from Vani Vihar Square to Sishu Bhawan Square (5.5 km) + 0.3 km to Railway Station
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Transformed Janpath from a vehicle-dominated road into a pedestrian-friendly street with wider footpaths, cycle lanes, median landscaping, and parking zones. Completed as confirmed by BSCL in June 2024.

title: BMC-ICOMC Tower — Integrated City Operations & Management Centre Building
authority: Bhubaneswar Smart City Limited (BSCL) / Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: 11-storey building. ICOMC occupies floors 1-2; BMC headquarters on upper floors. Completed and operationalized in October 2022. BSCL office relocated here from Bhawani Mall in February 2023.

title: Intelligent Traffic Control System — Adaptive Signal Control at 50 Intersections
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Pan City Solutions
notes: Composite Signal Control Strategy (CoSiCoSt) developed by C-DAC. Adaptive signal control system installed and operational at 43 intersections, with pelican signals and blinkers across the city.

title: Multilevel Car Parking — RajMahal Square
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Multilevel automated car parking facility at RajMahal Square to address acute parking shortage in the central Bhubaneswar area. Part of the 32-project Smart Cities Mission portfolio (31 of 32 completed by Aug 2024).

title: Multilevel Car Parking — Saheed Nagar
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Multilevel automated car parking facility in Saheed Nagar commercial area. Part of the Smart Cities Mission, completed as part of the 31 of 32 projects finished by August 2024.

title: Smart Park — Saheed Nagar Park Redevelopment
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Modernization and redevelopment of Saheed Nagar Park with smart features, landscaping, amphitheatre, and public amenities.

title: Integrated Public Service Centre — Jan Seva Kendra
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Provides integrated government-to-citizen services under one roof. Citizens can access 100+ services including birth/death certificates, trade licenses, and grievance redressal.

title: Street Vendors Improvement Project — Hawker Zone Development
funding_source: Smart Cities Mission — Area Based Development
notes: Formalized designated zones for street vendors with proper utilities, hygiene, and signage. Reduced encroachment and improved city aesthetics.
